shouldFix.title: DEF-ROLE-NON-TS is an outside-FDB wildcard, not a result rule for the concrete non-TypeScript role cells the contract still constructs
shouldFix.counterexample: Let comparison-basis component A have custodied roleApplicability={Rust}, where Rust is a product-selected DR-118 role other than TypeScript. roleApplicability.rule and effectiveRoleAxis require A's axis to contain Rust, so fixtureDomainBasis.members contains A × Rust × each effective platform × every changeClass. The new DEF-ROLE-NON-TS object simultaneously says it is outside the FDB and is not an effectiveRoleAxis member. coverageLaw attaches DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN to that one wildcard sentinel, but no clause maps A's concrete Rust cells to the sentinel or expands the sentinel across component/platform/changeClass. Those FDB cells therefore remain caught between running a preview-excluded role, being omitted, or receiving a disposition the law assigns only to the outside-FDB sentinel.
shouldFix.measurement: The v13-to-v14 delta changes coverageLaw and appends the generic slot, but leaves members, effectiveRoleAxis, G16-10, and G16-14 unchanged. D-002 and the live DR-118 row identify TypeScript as the sole current slice role; they do not supply a concrete non-TypeScript role set for the wildcard value 'any ... role other than TypeScript'. If no such role is currently selected, the slot names an unexpanded category rather than a concrete matrix cell; if one is later selected, the unchanged effectiveRoleAxis puts its concrete cells inside the FDB. Thus neither branch gives one exact closed domain/result mapping. This is SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker because the current D-002 active-role set is TypeScript only.
shouldFix.risk: A successor harness can disagree about cardinality, FDB reconciliation, and the qualification-neutral result when a non-TypeScript role is introduced, or silently satisfy one wildcard slot while omitting the component × role × platform × change-class cells G16-10 promises.
shouldFix.suggestedFix: Choose one explicit model. Either define a digest-bound concrete deferred-role set, exclude those concrete roles from effectiveRoleAxis for this preview, and specify the deferred slot's full component/platform/changeClass expansion; or retain each concrete role in the FDB and assign its cells an explicit qualification-neutral result. Update roleApplicability, members/effectiveRoleAxis, coverageLaw, G16-10/G16-14, and the live source claim together.
